simple.prompt: You are the new project manager, ___?
simple.explanation: Kalimat positif dengan to be 'are' berpasangan dengan question tag negatif: 'aren't you?'.
Kalimat negatif dengan auxiliary 'doesn't' berpasangan dengan question tag positif: 'does she?'.
hints: Kalimat negatif berpasangan dengan tag positif.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan question tag positif.
simple.explanation: Kalimat negatif (They weren't surprised) + tag positif (were they?).
Present Simple positif dengan subjek orang ketiga tunggal (speaks) menggunakan auxiliary negatif: 'doesn't he?'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan question tag Past Simple.
simple.targetSentence: He finished the report didn't he?
simple.explanation: Kalimat positif Past Simple (He finished the report) + tag negatif (didn't he?).
hints: Past Simple positif: 'He finished the report'.

simple.prompt: We have met before at the Singapore summit, ___?
simple.explanation: Present Perfect positif (have met) berpasangan dengan tag: 'haven't we?'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat modal dengan question tag.
simple.targetSentence: She can drive a manual car can't she?
simple.explanation: Modal positif (can drive) + tag negatif (can't she?).
hints: Mulai dengan 'She can drive a manual car'.

simple.prompt: The conference starts at nine o'clock, ___?
simple.explanation: Pernyataan positif Present Simple dengan verb 'starts' dan subjek benda tunggal 'The conference' menggunakan question tag negatif 'doesn't it'.
hints: Tag untuk Present Simple positif tunggal: 'doesn't it'.

simple.prompt: Your colleagues weren't at the morning briefing, ___?
simple.explanation: Kalimat utama berbentuk negatif ('weren't'), sehingga tag-nya positif ('were they'); 'Your colleagues' diwakili pronoun 'they'.

simple.prompt: Maya has already uploaded the contract, ___?
simple.explanation: Auxiliary pada klausa utama adalah 'has' (Present Perfect), sehingga tag-nya langsung mengulang 'hasn't she'.
hints: Ulangi auxiliary yang sama dalam bentuk negatif.

simple.prompt: We should test the backup projector first, ___?
simple.explanation: Modal 'should' langsung diulang pada tag negatif menjadi 'shouldn't we'.
hints: Tag selalu mengulang modal yang sama.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan pengecekan kepastian memakai tag.
dialogue: Host
You won't forget to lock the side entrance, ___?
Guard
Of course not — I always double-check every bolt.
simple.explanation: 'Won't' adalah bentuk negatif dari 'will', sehingga question tag-nya berbentuk positif: 'will you'.

simple.prompt: They finished the inventory check yesterday, ___?
simple.explanation: Pernyataan positif Past Simple ('finished') tanpa auxiliary memakai auxiliary bantu 'did' dalam tag negatif: 'didn't they'.
hints: Verb utama berada di bentuk V2 ('finished').

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan mengganti pronoun nama benda dengan 'this' di dalam question tag berikut.
simple.draft: This ergonomic keyboard feels comfortable, doesn't this?
options: This ergonomic keyboard feels comfortable, doesn't it?
This ergonomic keyboard feels comfortable, isn't it?
This ergonomic keyboard feels comfortable, don't it?
simple.explanation: Dalam question tag, subjek 'this/that + noun' atau 'this/that' tunggal harus diganti menjadi pronoun 'it' (bukan mengulang 'this').
hints: Question tag selalu memakai pronoun pribadi ('it', 'they', 'he', 'she', 'there').

simple.prompt: There isn't any ink left in the color printer, ___?
simple.explanation: Jika subjek kalimat diawali 'There' ('There isn't...'), question tag tetap mempertahankan kata 'there' ('is there').
hints: Kalimat negatif 'isn't' berpasangan dengan positif 'is there'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat ber-question tag untuk subjek jamak Present Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: The technicians are calibrating the sound system, aren't they?
simple.explanation: Auxiliary 'are' berbalik menjadi negatif 'aren't' dengan pronoun 'they'.
hints: Awali dengan 'The technicians are calibrating the sound system,'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif dengan modal 'can' dan tag positifnya.
simple.targetSentence: She can't access the server without a token, can she?
hints: Mulai dengan 'She can't access the server without a token,'.

dialogue: Colleague
I am scheduled to deliver the presentation first, ___?
Coordinator
Yes, you are right after the keynote address.
intermediate.explanation: Pengecualian baku bahasa Inggris: tag negatif untuk 'I am' adalah 'aren't I?' (bukan amn't I).

intermediate.prompt: Imperative tag untuk ajakan 'Let's': 'Let's take a short coffee break, ___?'
intermediate.explanation: Setelah ajakan 'Let's...', question tag baku yang selalu digunakan adalah 'shall we?'.

intermediate.prompt: Imperative tag untuk instruksi: 'Close the conference room door, ___?'
intermediate.explanation: Untuk kalimat perintah atau permintaan (imperative), question tag yang umum digunakan adalah 'will you?' atau 'would you?'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan indefinite pronoun subjek 'they' pada tag.
intermediate.targetSentence: Everybody was satisfied with the outcome weren't they?
intermediate.explanation: Kata ganti indefinit seperti everybody/everyone bernilai tunggal pada klausa utama, namun digantikan oleh pronoun jamak 'they' pada tag: 'weren't they?'.
hints: To be menyesuaikan menjadi jamak: 'weren't they?'.

intermediate.prompt: Kalimat dengan kata negatif implisit: 'She rarely attends the Friday meetings, ___?'
intermediate.explanation: Kata 'rarely', 'seldom', 'never', dan 'hardly' membuat klausa utama bernilai negatif, sehingga question tag WAJIB positif: 'does she?'.
hints: Tag harus dalam bentuk positif: 'does she?'.

intermediate.targetSentence: Nothing went wrong during the deployment did it?
intermediate.explanation: 'Nothing' bernilai negatif dan digantikan oleh pronoun 'it' pada tag positif: 'did it?'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih intonasi dan konfirmasi yang tepat.
dialogue: Speaker
You haven't seen my car keys anywhere, ___?
Colleague
No, I haven't seen them all morning.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa negatif (haven't seen) + tag positif (have you?).

intermediate.prompt: I am listed as the backup presenter for Tuesday's panel, ___?
intermediate.explanation: Pengecualian terkenal: untuk kalimat positif 'I am...', bentuk question tag negatif yang baku adalah 'aren't I?' (bukan 'amn't I').
hints: Periksa subjek 'I am...' di kalimat positif.
Pengecualian baku untuk 'I am' adalah 'aren't I'.

intermediate.prompt: Let's grab a quick lunch before the afternoon workshop starts, ___?
intermediate.explanation: Kalimat ajakan yang diawali 'Let's...' ('Let us...') selalu menggunakan question tag khusus 'shall we?'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan permintaan sopan memakai kalimat perintah + tag.
dialogue: Designer
Please send me the high-resolution logo when you get a minute, ___?
Intern
Sure thing! I'll email it right after lunch.
intermediate.explanation: Kalimat perintah atau permintaan sopan ('Open the door...', 'Please send me...') umumnya menggunakan tag 'will you?' atau 'would you?' (atau 'can you?').
hints: Tag baku untuk kalimat perintah sopan adalah 'will you?'.

intermediate.prompt: Nobody in the regional branch objected to the new hybrid policy, ___?
intermediate.explanation: Dua aturan penting sekaligus: 1) 'Nobody' bermakna negatif → tag POSITIF ('did'); 2) 'Nobody/Everyone/Someone' memakai pronoun 'they' di dalam tag!
hints: 'Nobody' sudah bernilai negatif, jadi tag harus positif.
Kata ganti untuk 'nobody' di question tag selalu 'they'.

intermediate.prompt: Everyone deserves a quiet workspace during focus hours, ___?
intermediate.explanation: Meskipun 'Everyone' diikuti verb tunggal ('deserves'), question tag-nya wajib menggunakan pronoun jamak 'they', sehingga auxiliary ikut menyesuaikan menjadi 'don't they'.
hints: Because pronoun tag is 'they', pakai 'don't they' (bukan 'doesn't').

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan bentuk tag untuk kata keterangan bermakna negatif 'hardly' berikut.
intermediate.draft: Our rural clinic hardly ever experiences power outages, doesn't it?
options: Our rural clinic hardly ever experiences power outages, does it?
Our rural clinic hardly ever experiences power outages, isn't it?
Our rural clinic hardly ever experiences power outages, do they?
intermediate.explanation: Kata semi-negatif seperti 'hardly', 'seldom', 'rarely', dan 'never' membuat klausa utama bersifat NEGATIF secara makna, sehingga question tag-nya wajib POSITIF ('does it?').
hints: 'Hardly ever' membuat kalimat bermakna hampir tidak pernah (negatif).
Tag untuk kalimat bermakna negatif harus positif: 'does it?'.

intermediate.prompt: Nothing went missing during the office relocation, ___?
intermediate.explanation: 'Nothing' dan 'everything' merujuk pada benda (bukan manusia), sehingga pronoun tag-nya adalah 'it'; dan karena 'Nothing' negatif, tag-nya positif: 'did it'.

intermediate.prompt: There used to be a quiet bookstore across from the campus gate, ___?
intermediate.explanation: 'Used to' (kebiasaan masa lalu) menggunakan auxiliary lampau 'didn't' pada question tag, dan tetap menjaga 'there' ('didn't there?').

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pengecualian question tag dengan 'I'm'.
intermediate.targetSentence: I am scheduled to lead the morning onboarding session, aren't I?
intermediate.explanation: 'I am...' positif memakai tag negatif baku 'aren't I?'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'I am scheduled to lead the morning onboarding session,'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan subjek 'Somebody' yang berganti menjadi 'they' di tag.
intermediate.targetSentence: Somebody left the projector remote on the podium, didn't they?
intermediate.explanation: Past Simple positif ('left') + subjek manusia tak tentu 'Somebody' menghasilkan tag 'didn't they?'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Somebody left the projector remote on the podium,'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan tag pada klausa opini 'I don't think'.
complex.draft: I don't think the board will approve the acquisition, won't they?
options: I don't think the board will approve the acquisition, will they?
I don't think the board will approve the acquisition, do I?
I don't think the board will approve the acquisition, wouldn't they?
complex.explanation: Pada konstruksi 'I don't think + clause', negasi ditransfer dari klausa utama (transferred negation). Tag merujuk pada klausa subordinat ('the board will approve') dan harus berbentuk POSITIF: 'will they?'.
hints: Negasi 'don't think' membuat klausa ide bernilai negatif.
Tag harus positif merujuk pada dewan: 'will they?'.

complex.prompt: Intonasi turun (falling intonation) pada question tag menandakan bahwa pembicara...
options: hanya meminta persetujuan / konfirmasi atas fakta yang sudah pasti diketahui
benar-benar bertanya karena tidak tahu jawabannya sama sekali
complex.explanation: Intonasi menurun (falling pitch) pada tag berarti pembicara tidak benar-benar bertanya, melainkan sekadar mengharapkan konfirmasi/persetujuan atas hal yang sudah ia yakini.
hints: Intonasi turun pada tag menandakan kepastian/konfirmasi.

complex.prompt: Tag untuk subjek semu 'There': 'There isn't any milk left in the refrigerator, ___?'
complex.explanation: Pada klausa yang diawali dummy 'There', subjek pada question tag tetap menggunakan 'there': 'is there?'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat instruksi negatif dengan tag 'will you'.
complex.targetSentence: Don't forget to lock the gate will you?
complex.explanation: Negative imperative: Don't forget + tag (will you?).
hints: Mulai dengan perintah negatif 'Don't forget to lock the gate'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi pemilihan pronoun pada tag dengan subjek 'this/that'.
complex.draft: That is your new company laptop, isn't that?
options: That is your new company laptop, isn't it?
That is your new company laptop, isn't that one?
That is your new company laptop, is it?
complex.explanation: Kata penunjuk 'this' atau 'that' pada subjek digantikan oleh personal pronoun 'it' pada question tag: 'isn't it?' (bukan isn't that).

complex.prompt: Tag untuk subjek jamak 'these/those': 'These are the finalized audit spreadsheets, ___?'
complex.explanation: 'These' atau 'those' pada subjek digantikan oleh personal pronoun jamak 'they' pada question tag: 'aren't they?'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tag dengan klausa kompleks.
dialogue: Analyst
Nobody had anticipated the sudden market downturn, ___?
Senior Partner
No, it caught the entire financial sector completely off guard.
complex.explanation: 'Nobody' bernilai negatif lampau dan digantikan oleh pronoun 'they' pada tag positif: 'had they?'.
hints: Tag positif dengan Past Perfect: 'had they?'.

complex.prompt: Notice the transferred negation rule with opinion clauses: 'I don't think the client approved the new fee schedule, ___?'
complex.explanation: Saat kalimat diawali 'I don't think / suppose / believe + that-clause', tag MENGIKUTI klausa kedua ('the client approved'), DAN karena 'don't' di depan memindahkan negasi ke seluruh kalimat, tag-nya POSITIF: 'did they?' (atau 'did he/she?').
hints: Tag tidak bertanya tentang 'I think', melainkan tentang isi klausa kedua.
Negasi pada 'don't think' membuat tag pada klausa kedua menjadi positif.

complex.prompt: Compare with an ordinary statement verb like 'He said / She noticed': 'She noticed that you updated the charts, ___?'
complex.explanation: Berbeda dengan 'I think/don't think' (orang pertama), untuk subjek pihak ketiga ('She noticed...', 'They believe...'), question tag tetap merujuk pada subjek utama ('She noticed' → 'didn't she?').
hints: Subjek depannya adalah orang ketiga 'She noticed'.
Pada subjek orang ketiga, tag mengikuti klausa utama 'She'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda penggunaan auxiliary pada kalimat 'have' (kepemilikan vs aksi) berikut.
complex.draft: You have lunch at twelve every afternoon, haven't you?
options: You have lunch at twelve every afternoon, don't you?
You have lunch at twelve every afternoon, aren't you?
You have lunch at twelve every afternoon, didn't you?
complex.explanation: Di sini 'have lunch' bermakna aksi makan (Present Simple main verb, BUKAN auxiliary Present Perfect 'have + V3'), sehingga question tag wajib memakai 'don't you?' (bukan 'haven't you?').
hints: Periksa apakah 'have' di sini berarti 'sudah (V3)' atau aktivitas 'makan'.
Aktivitas rutin Present Simple memakai auxiliary 'do/don't'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang intonasi question tag (naik vs turun).
dialogue: Coach
If a speaker uses FALLING intonation on 'It's a pleasant day, isn't it?', what is their communicative intent?
Student
Falling intonation signals that the speaker ___.
options: is fairly certain and mainly invites agreement or small talk
genuinely has no idea and needs factual verification
is expressing sudden anger or refusal
complex.explanation: Dalam fonologi pragmatis bahasa Inggris, intonasi TURUN pada question tag menandakan pembicara sudah yakin dan sekadar mengajak lawan bicara setuju; intonasi NAIK barulah menandakan pertanyaan sungguhan karena ragu.
hints: Bedakan fungsi intonasi turun (mencari persetujuan) vs naik (sungguh bertanya).

complex.prompt: Even though the team works independently, neither co-founder wants to delay the launch, ___?
complex.explanation: 'Neither co-founder' sudah mengandung makna negatif ('neither' = not either) dan secara standar memakai pronoun 'they' di tag positif ('do they?').
hints: 'Neither + noun tunggal' umum memakai pronoun tag 'they'.

complex.prompt: Look at negative imperative: 'Don't forget to attach the signed PDF before sending, ___?'
complex.explanation: Setelah perintah negatif ('Don't...'), question tag tetap menggunakan bentuk positif 'will you?' (bukan 'won't you?' maupun 'do you?').
hints: Kalimat perintah negatif ('Don't...') selalu memakai satu jenis tag positif.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum penggunaan tag untuk 'I don't suppose...' berikut.
complex.draft: I don't suppose you have a spare USB-C cable in your backpack, do I?
options: I don't suppose you have a spare USB-C cable in your backpack, do you?
I don't suppose you have a spare USB-C cable in your backpack, don't you?
I don't suppose you have a spare USB-C cable in your backpack, haven't I?
complex.explanation: Dengan 'I don't suppose...', fokus tag terletak pada klausa kedua ('you have...' → positif 'do you?'), bukan pada subjek 'I'.
hints: Negasi 'don't suppose' membuat tag menjadi positif 'do you?'.

complex.prompt: Same-way tag (positive statement + positive tag): 'So you redesigned the whole portal over the weekend, ___?' expresses...
complex.explanation: Pola positif + positif ('You did..., did you?') dipakai secara pragmatis untuk mengekspresikan keterkejutan, kekaguman, atau kecurigaan atas informasi baru yang baru didengar.
hints: Positive + positive tag mengekspresikan reaksi terkejut atau menyimpulkan.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat transferred negation dengan 'I don't believe'.
complex.targetSentence: I don't believe the customs office processed our shipment yet, did they?
complex.explanation: 'I don't believe...' mengalihkan tag ke klausa kedua dalam bentuk positif 'did they?'.
hints: Awali dengan 'I don't believe the customs office processed'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat perintah positif yang menggunakan tag permintaan sopan.
complex.targetSentence: Pass me that stainless steel ruler when you're done, could you?
complex.explanation: Tag modal 'could you?' atau 'will you?' melembutkan kalimat imperatif menjadi permintaan ramah.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Pass me that stainless steel ruler when you're done,'.
